PB.guidance: Problem-domain narrative carrier; verified situational facts; compact opening arc; no goal tables or capability lists.

required: Opens with problem narrative before goal or enumeration blocks
forbidden: Before→after or success-state table carriers (belongs in GO)
Capability or scope enumeration tables (belongs in SC)
File paths, APIs, or stack choices

RN.guidance: Why-now trigger narrative; at most one bridging phrase from PB; urgency or window framing; no capability or flow content.

required: At most one transitional bridging phrase before trigger/urgency content
forbidden: Before→after goal table carriers (belongs in GO)
Capability or I/O enumerations (belongs in SC/IO)

GO.guidance: Observable before→after or success-state prose/table carrier; at most one upstream bridging phrase; brief rejected-direction note inline when decision-doc compares options.

required: When table carrier is used: two-column Before→After or equivalent success-state view
At most one transitional bridging phrase before the outcomes block
forbidden: Capability or scope enumeration tables (belongs in SC)

UR.guidance: User role list or short persona carrier; enumeration when more than one primary user; no scenario story bodies.

required: When multiple user roles appear: structured list or table carrier rather than inline prose only
forbidden: Full scenario narrative with steps (belongs in SN)
Capability or I/O object enumerations (belongs in SC/IO)

SN.guidance: Scenario narrative carrier with at least one concrete example slot; users established upstream — do not re-enumerate UR.

required: [Optional] One concrete scenario example slot with situational context
forbidden: Capability or I/O object enumerations (belongs in SC/IO)

SC.guidance: Capability enumeration carrier; prefer list or table when item count exceeds two; no step-by-step flow.

required: H3 narrative order relative to IO: SC capabilities before I/O surfaces in document flow
When more than two capability items appear: structured or list carrier rather than inline prose only

IO.guidance: I/O object enumeration carrier following SC; list or table form; map objects to SC capabilities when both appear.

required: When I/O objects appear: structured list or table carrier

FL.guidance: Single happy-path flow carrier: entry → main path steps → exit condition; no acceptance or scope expansion.

required: Single happy-path flow structure (entry, main path, exit condition)

NG.guidance: Bullet or short two-column exclusion carrier; one row or bullet per exclusion with brief boundary-protection note; do not repeat SC body.

required: Each exclusion occupies one bullet or one table row — no nested rationale essays inside a single row

AC.guidance: Observable acceptance checklist or trace-table carrier; row-aligned trace-back to GO or FL when decision-doc names goal or flow ids.

required: Observable acceptance item list as primary structure
When decision-doc names goal or flow ids: trace-back labels to GO or FL in the same row or adjacent column
forbidden: New capabilities or scope expansion (belongs in SC)
